description: Defines the CandidateInterviewModel class used for representing interview data in the Recruitment API of the OrangeHRM system. Implements serialization and normalization logic for CandidateInterview entities, including attribute filtering and mapping.

classes.name: CandidateInterviewModel
classes.description: A model class representing interview information, including candidate details, vacancy, interviewers, date, time, and notes, used for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Interview entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

parameters.name: $interview
parameters.description: The Interview entity to be transformed into API model.
